    Diagonal cokernels from common radical extensions #

    Two one-step extensions of the same nonsimple uniserial module give the diagonal cokernel used to exclude a nonsemisimple biserial branch intersection. This file packages its layer identifications and discharges its indecomposability criterion from ambient coordinate thinness.

    source
    def MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.moduleTopQuotientLinearEquiv {A : Type u} [Ring A] (M : FinitelyGeneratedCategory A) (K : Submodule Aᵐᵒᵖ ↑M) (hK : K ≤ Module.jacobson Aᵐᵒᵖ ↑M) :
    ((↑M ⧸ K) ⧸ Module.jacobson Aᵐᵒᵖ (↑M ⧸ K)) ≃ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] ↑M ⧸ Module.jacobson Aᵐᵒᵖ ↑M

    Quotienting below the radical canonically preserves the module top.
